<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600">
  <title>Pythagoras' Theorem</title>
  
  <style>
    text {
      font-family: sans-serif;
      font-weight: bold;
    }
    .label-a { fill: #2b6cb0; }
    .label-b { fill: #c53030; }
    .label-c { fill: #2f855a; }
    
    @keyframes pulse-sq {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.3; }
      50% { opacity: 0.5; }
    }
    .sq-anim {
      animation: pulse-sq 3s infinite ease-in-out;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="600" fill="#f7fafc" />

  <!-- Title & Subtitle -->
  <text x="400" y="45" font-size="28" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2d3748">Pythagoras' Theorem</text>
  <text x="400" y="75" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4a5568">a² + b² = c²</text>

  <!-- Definitions -->
  <rect x="500" y="420" width="260" height="130" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e0" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="520" y="455" font-size="16" class="label-a">a² : Area on side a</text>
  <text x="520" y="490" font-size="16" class="label-b">b² : Area on side b</text>
  <text x="520" y="525" font-size="16" class="label-c">c² : Area on hypotenuse c</text>

  <!-- 
       Right-angled triangle coordinates:
       Let's place vertex C (right angle) at (320, 320)
       Side a goes UP to (320, 170) -> length 150 (3 units * 50)
       Side b goes RIGHT to (470, 320) -> length 150 (3 units * 50)  Wait, let's make it 3-4-5 scale or similar.
       Let's use scale: 1 unit = 40 pixels.
       a = 3 units = 120 px
       b = 4 units = 160 px
       c = 5 units = 200 px
       
       Right angle at (260, 340)
       Top vertex: A_top = (260, 340 - 120) = (260, 220)  [side a = 120]
       Right vertex: B_right = (260 + 160, 340) = (420, 340) [side b = 160]
       Hypotenuse connects (260, 220) to (420, 340) [length = 200]
  -->

  <!-- Squares on sides -->
  
  <!-- Square on side a (left, 120x120) built outwards to the left -->
  <g class="sq-anim">
    <rect x="140" y="220" width="120" height="120" fill="#ebf8ff" stroke="#3182ce" stroke-width="3"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Grid lines for square a -->
  <line x1="140" y1="260" x2="260" y2="260" stroke="#90cdf4" stroke-dasharray="4"/>
  <line x1="140" y1="300" x2="260" y2="300" stroke="#90cdf4" stroke-dasharray="4"/>
  <line x1="180" y1="220" x2="180" y2="340" stroke="#90cdf4" stroke-dasharray="4"/>
  <line x1="220" y1="220" x2="220" y2="340" stroke="#90cdf4" stroke-dasharray="4"/>

  <!-- Square on side b (bottom, 160x160) built outwards downwards -->
  <g class="sq-anim">
    <rect x="260" y="340" width="160" height="160" fill="#fff5f5" stroke="#e53e3e" stroke-width="3"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Grid lines for square b -->
  <line x1="300" y1="340" x2="300" y2="500" stroke="#feb2b2" stroke-dasharray="4"/>
  <line x1="340" y1="340" x2="340" y2="500" stroke="#feb2b2" stroke-dasharray="4"/>
  <line x1="380" y1="340" x2="380" y2="500" stroke="#feb2b2" stroke-dasharray="4"/>
  <line x1="260" y1="380" x2="420" y2="380" stroke="#feb2b2" stroke-dasharray="4"/>
  <line x1="260" y1="420" x2="420" y2="420" stroke="#feb2b2" stroke-dasharray="4"/>
  <line x1="260" y1="460" x2="420" y2="460" stroke="#feb2b2" stroke-dasharray="4"/>

  <!-- Square on hypotenuse c (200x200) built outwards up-right -->
  <!-- Vector from (260,220) to (420,340) is dx=160, dy=120. 
       Perpendicular outward vector is (-120, 160). Normalized & scaled to 200: 
       Actually, standard rotation: dx' = dy = 120, dy' = -dx = -160.
       Top-left of hypotenuse square is (260, 220), top-right is (420, 340).
       Wait, let's construct it precisely using polygon vertices:
       P1 = (260, 220)
       P2 = (420, 340)
       P3 = P2 + (-120, -160) = (300, 180) -> Let's check geometry:
       Vector P1->P2 is (160, 120). Perp outward is (-120, 160).
       P4 = P1 + (-120, 160) = (140, 380)? No, let's use exact coordinates for 3-4-5 triangle square.
       For a triangle with legs 160 and 120, hypotenuse is 200.
       The square on hypotenuse extends upwards and to the right.
       Vertices: (260, 220), (420, 340), and offset by (-120, 160)... 
       Let's use simple verified coordinates for the c² square:
       Vertex A: (260, 220)
       Vertex B: (420, 340)
       Vertex C_sq: (540, 180)
       Vertex D_sq: (380, 60)
       Let's verify side lengths:
       (420-260)^2 + (340-220)^2 = 160^2 + 120^2 = 25600 + 14400 = 40000 -> sqrt = 200. Correct.
       (540-420)^2 + (180-340)^2 = 120^2 + (-160)^2 = 14400 + 25600 = 40000 -> sqrt = 200. Correct.
       (380-540)^2 + (60-180)^2 = (-160)^2 + (-120)^2 = 25600 + 14400 = 40000 -> sqrt = 200. Correct.
       (260-380)^2 + (220-60)^2 = (-120)^2 + (160)^2 = 14400 + 25600 = 40000 -> sqrt = 200. Correct.
  -->
  <g class="sq-anim">
    <polygon points="260,220 420,340 540,180 380,60" fill="#f0fff4" stroke="#38a169" stroke-width="3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Central Right-Angled Triangle (drawn on top of squares) -->
  <polygon points="260,220 260,340 420,340" fill="#fff" stroke="#1a202c" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Right angle marker -->
  <polyline points="260,320 280,320 280,340" fill="none" stroke="#1a202c" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Side Labels -->
  <!-- Side a -->
  <text x="235" y="285" font-size="20" class="label-a" text-anchor="middle">a</text>
  <!-- Side b -->
  <text x="340" y="365" font-size="20" class="label-b" text-anchor="middle">b</text>
  <!-- Side c (Hypotenuse) -->
  <text x="325" y="270" font-size="20" class="label-c" text-anchor="middle">c</text>

  <!-- Square area labels inside the squares -->
  <text x="200" y="285" font-size="22" class="label-a" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0.8">a²</text>
  <text x="340" y="425" font-size="22" class="label-b" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0.8">b²</text>
  <text x="450" y="235" font-size="22" class="label-c" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0.8">c²</text>

  <!-- Animated floating indicator to show a² + b² = c² -->
  <g>
    <rect x="80" y="500" width="360" height="60" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e0" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="260" y="536" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2d3748">
      <tspan class="label-a">a²</tspan> <tspan fill="#2d3748">+</tspan> <tspan class="label-b">b²</tspan> <tspan fill="#2d3748">=</tspan> <tspan class="label-c">c²</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <!-- Pulsing highlight circle -->
    <circle cx="110" cy="530" r="15" fill="#3182ce" opacity="0.2">
      <animate attributeName="r" values="10;18;10" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
  </g>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600">
  <title>States of Matter - GCSE Chemistry</title>
  <style>
    .bg { fill: #f8fafc; }
    .box { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #cbd5e1; stroke-width: 3; rx: 12; }
    .label { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1e293b; text-anchor: middle; }
    .sublabel { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; fill: #64748b; text-anchor: middle; }
    .particle { fill: #3b82f6; stroke: #1d4ed8; stroke-width: 2; }
    .liquid-particle { fill: #10b981; stroke: #047857; stroke-width: 2; }
    .gas-particle { fill: #ef4444; stroke: #b91c1c; stroke-width: 2; }
    .arrow { stroke: #94a3b8; stroke-width: 3; fill: none; stroke-dasharray: 6 6; }
    
    /* Solid particle vibration */
    @keyframes vibrate {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(-2px, 1px); }
      50% { transform: translate(1px, -2px); }
      75% { transform: translate(2px, 2px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    .v1 { animation: vibrate 0.3s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .v2 { animation: vibrate 0.25s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .v3 { animation: vibrate 0.35s infinite ease-in-out; }

    /* Gas fast movement */
    @keyframes bounce1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(-30px, 40px); }
      66% { transform: translate(25px, -30px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes bounce2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(35px, -25px); }
      66% { transform: translate(-20px, 35px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes bounce3 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(-40px, -20px); }
      66% { transform: translate(30px, 30px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes bounce4 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(20px, 45px); }
      66% { transform: translate(-35px, -15px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }

    .g1 { animation: bounce1 1.2s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .g2 { animation: bounce2 1.0s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .g3 { animation: bounce3 1.4s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .g4 { animation: bounce4 1.1s infinite ease-in-out; }

    /* Liquid flow movement */
    @keyframes flow1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      50% { transform: translate(12px, -8px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }

      <!-- Row 3 -->
      <circle cx="20" cy="110" r="14" class="particle v2" />
      <circle cx="60" cy="110" r="14" class="particle v3" />
      <circle cx="100" cy="110" r="14" class="particle v1" />
      <circle cx="140" cy="110" r="14" class="particle v2" />
      <!-- Row 4 -->
      <circle cx="20" cy="155" r="14" class="particle v1" />
      <circle cx="60" cy="155" r="14" class="particle v2" />
      <circle cx="100" cy="155" r="14" class="particle v3" />
      <circle cx="140" cy="155" r="14" class="particle v1" />
      <!-- Row 5 -->
      <circle cx="20" cy="200" r="14" class="particle v3" />
      <circle cx="60" cy="200" r="14" class="particle v1" />

      <circle cx="140" cy="200" r="14" class="particle v3" />
    </g>

    <text x="105" y="340" class="sublabel" style="font-size: 13px;">• Strong forces</text>
    <text x="105" y="360" class="sublabel" style="font-size: 13px;">• Fixed shape & volume</text>
  </g>
